fields.place_of_incident: Ganga Vihar, near the community hall

narrative: I, Kamal Pandey, live at the above address with my family and work as a farmer.
On 6th Dec 2024 at about 14.25 hrs, we locked the house and went to visit relatives in a nearby village.
When we came back, I saw that the lock of the main door was broken.
Gold ornaments and cash worth Rs 6,00,000/- were missing from the steel almirah in the bedroom.
The back door of the house was found open.
My neighbour told me that he had seen Tarun Gill near my house that evening.
Tarun Gill went away on a grey motorcycle with registration number ZZ 21 GH 7430.
A shop near the community hall has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
Two days later, I saw Tarun Gill again near the community hall.
My cousin was with me at that time.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
A few days before the incident, on a Wednesday, I had seen the accused near my house.
The place where it happened, near the community hall, is usually busy.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

narrative: My name is Smt Anita Sharma. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a driver.
At around 10:25 AM on 7th Feb 2026, I was walking home from work near the bus stand.
Rohit Shukla stopped me there and abused me because of an old dispute about a boundary wall.
He hit me twice on my head with a wooden stick, and I fell down.
He did say that he would kill me if I went to the police.
During the attack, my mobile phone worth Rs 14,000/- fell and was broken.
He ran away on a scooter bearing number ZZ 06 JK 3548.
The place where it happened, near the bus stand, is usually busy.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
I saw Rohit Shukla again near the bus stand two days later.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
At that time, my brother was with me.
I request that my identity and address be kept safe.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Canal Road, near the government school

narrative: I, Shri Raghav Rathore, live at the above address with my family and work as a shopkeeper.
On 13 October 2025 at about 06:10, I received a call from a person who said he was a bank officer.
The caller told me that my account would be blocked if I did not share a one-time password.
I did give him the password.
Shortly afterwards, Rs 2,75,779/- was taken from my account in four transactions.
I later came to know that the money was sent to an account in the name of Manoj Shah.
Manoj Shah visited the bank branch on a motorcycle with registration number ZZ38AB7302.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs 2,75,779/-.
A shop near the government school has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
I have never given money or property to the accused before.
At that time, my cousin was with me.
A few days before the incident, on a Sunday, I had seen the accused near my house.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
The place where it happened, near the government school, is usually busy.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
I saw Manoj Shah again near the government school two days later.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

On 18th May 2025, at around 16:05, my family and I locked the house and left to visit relatives in a nearby village.
On our return, I found the lock of the main door broken.
Gold ornaments and cash worth Rs 7,15,000/- were missing from the steel almirah in the bedroom.
We found that the kitchen door of the house was open.
According to my neighbour, he had seen Dinesh Tiwari near my house that evening.
Dinesh Tiwari left on a red motorcycle bearing number ZZ-20-PQ-9360.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
Two days later, I saw Dinesh Tiwari again near the vegetable market.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
A shop near the vegetable market has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
I can identify the accused if I see him again.
I request that my identity and address be kept safe.
The place where it happened, near the vegetable market, is usually busy.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs 7,15,000/-.
A few days before the incident, on a Wednesday, I had seen the accused near my house.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

Someone had taken cash worth Rs 61,000/- from the locker.
I found all the goods from the front shelf lying on the floor.
The night watchman told me that he saw Anil Shah near the shop at midnight.
That night, a black van with registration number ZZ 31 XY 9048 was parked outside the shop.
The CCTV camera of the shop was working at that time.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs 61,000/-.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Wednesday.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
The street lights in the area were working that night.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
I request that my identity and address be kept safe.
The place where it happened, near the government school, is usually busy.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

On 12th Sep 2024 at about 12.35 hrs, I was returning home from work near the government school.
Tarun Shukla stopped me and started abusing me over an old dispute about a parking space.
He struck my head twice with a brick, and I fell to the ground.
He did threaten to kill me if I went to the police.
My mobile phone, worth Rs. 33,500.00, fell and broke during the attack.
He escaped on a scooter with registration number ZZ 29 LM 3607.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Monday.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the government school, and its footage may help.
At that time, my brother was with me.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
The street lights in the area were working that night.
I saw Tarun Shukla again near the government school two days later.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs. 33,500.00.
The incident took place near the government school, which is a busy area.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Patel Chowk, near the community hall

narrative: I, Vikas Tiwari, live at the above address with my family and work as a clerk.
At around 5:40 PM on 15-06-2026, I was walking home from work near the community hall.
Shri Sandeep Thakur stopped me there and abused me because of an old dispute about a water connection.
He hit me twice on my head with a brick, and I fell down.
He did say that he would kill me if I went to the police.
My mobile phone, worth Rs. 24946, fell and broke during the attack.
He ran away on a scooter bearing number ZZ-19-PQ-8466.
The place where it happened, near the community hall, is usually busy.
A few days before the incident, on a Friday, I had seen the accused near my house.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
My cousin was with me at that time.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs. 24946.
I saw Shri Sandeep Thakur again near the community hall two days later.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the community hall, and its footage may help.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

narrative: I, Vikas Tiwari, live at the above address with my family and work as a clerk.
At around 5:40 PM on 15-06-2026, I was walking home from work near the community hall.
Shri Sandeep Thakur stopped me there and abused me because of an old dispute about a water connection.
He hit me twice on my head with a brick, and I fell down.
He did say that he would kill me if I went to the police.
My mobile phone, worth Rs. 24946, fell and broke during the attack.
He ran away on a scooter bearing number ZZ-19-PQ-8466.
The place where it happened, near the community hall, is usually busy.
A few days before the incident, on a Friday, I had seen the accused near my house.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
My cousin was with me at that time.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs. 24946.
I saw Shri Sandeep Thakur again near the community hall two days later.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the community hall, and its footage may help.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Mill Area, near the public library

narrative: My name is Bharat Sharma. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a driver.
On 7 October 2024, at around 11:40, my family and I locked the house and left to visit relatives in a nearby village.
On our return, I found the lock of the main door broken.
Gold ornaments and cash worth Rs 4,83,000/- were missing from the steel almirah in the bedroom.
We found that the side door of the house was open.
According to my neighbour, he had seen Pramod Pillai near my house that evening.
Pramod Pillai left on a grey motorcycle bearing number ZZ-38-CD-2672.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Wednesday.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs 4,83,000/-.
Two days later, I saw Pramod Pillai again near the public library.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

narrative: My name is Bharat Sharma. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a driver.
On 7 October 2024, at around 11:40, my family and I locked the house and left to visit relatives in a nearby village.
On our return, I found the lock of the main door broken.
Gold ornaments and cash worth Rs 4,83,000/- were missing from the steel almirah in the bedroom.
We found that the side door of the house was open.
According to my neighbour, he might have seen Pramod Pillai near my house that evening.
Pramod Pillai left on a grey motorcycle bearing number ZZ-38-CD-2672.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Wednesday.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs 4,83,000/-.
Two days later, I saw Pramod Pillai again near the public library.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Canal Road, near the water tank

narrative: My name is Prakash Qureshi. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a teacher.
On 23/07/2025 at about 11.45 hrs, we locked the house and went to visit relatives in a nearby village.
On our return, I found the lock of the main door broken.
Someone had taken gold ornaments and cash worth Rs 3,94,771/- from the trunk in the store room.
We found that the side door of the house was open.
My neighbour told me that he had seen Sanjay Agarwal near my house that evening.
Sanjay Agarwal left on a grey motorcycle bearing number ZZ 31 PQ 1945.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the water tank, and its footage may help.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs 3,94,771/-.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
The place where it happened, near the water tank, is usually busy.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
I saw Sanjay Agarwal again near the water tank two days later.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

narrative: I, Shri Gopal Thakur, live at the above address with my family and work as a clerk.

I had kept my blue mobile phone, worth Rs. 75740, in the inner pocket of my bag.
After I got down, I saw that the phone was gone.
According to a passenger, Nitin Ansari had been standing close to me.
I had locked the phone with a password.
Nitin Ansari was later seen getting off at the next stop.
The place where it happened, near the water tank, is usually busy.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
My brother was with me at that time.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
A shop near the water tank has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
I have never given money or property to the accused before.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Gandhi Colony, near the public library

narrative: I, Vikas Gupta, live at the above address with my family and work as a tailor.
At around 1:40 PM on 11/10/2025, a caller who claimed to be a bank officer phoned me.
The caller told me that my account would be blocked if I did not share a one-time password.
I did give him the password.
Soon after, Rs. 218000 was debited from my account in three transactions.
I later came to know that the money was sent to an account in the name of Mohan Singh.
Mohan Singh visited the bank branch on a motorcycle with registration number ZZ 10 TU 9092.
I saw Mohan Singh again near the public library two days later.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the public library, and its footage may help.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
The incident took place near the public library, which is a busy area.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs. 218000.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
A few days before the incident, on a Wednesday, I had seen the accused near my house.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Subhash Marg, near the vegetable market

narrative: My name is Shri Mahesh Qureshi. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a driver.
At around 17:40 on 06.09.2025, Shri Sandeep Qureshi came into the compound of my house, uninvited.
He got in by climbing over the side gate.
When I asked him to leave, he threatened me and broke a flower pot worth Rs. 18,000.00.
In the house, all the members of my family saw him in the compound.
He went away on a scooter with registration number ZZ-17-AB-2902.
He has done this before.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
Two days later, I saw Shri Sandeep Qureshi again near the vegetable market.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Friday.
At that time, my friend was with me.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I can identify the accused if I see him again.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.

I can identify the accused if I see him again.

I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs. 6,00,000.00.

I saw Prakash Pillai again near the post office two days later.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Hospital Road, near the temple gate

narrative: I, Anil Kulkarni, live at the above address with my family and work as a tailor.
On 07-10-2025, at around 14:30, my family and I locked the house and left to visit relatives in a nearby village.
On our return, I found the lock of the main door broken.
Gold ornaments and cash worth Rs. 1,17,136.00 were missing from the steel almirah in the bedroom.
We found that the kitchen door of the house was open.
My neighbour told me that he had seen Yogesh Kulkarni near my house that evening.
Yogesh Kulkarni left on a red motorcycle bearing number ZZ-26-RS-7777.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the temple gate, and its footage may help.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
At that time, my friend was with me.
A few days before the incident, on a Monday, I had seen the accused near my house.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs. 1,17,136.00.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Hospital Road, near the water tank

narrative: My name is Mahesh Ansari. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a clerk.
On 1 October 2025 at about 16.55 hrs, I was travelling in a crowded bus near the water tank.
My black mobile phone worth Rs 82,000/- was in the inner pocket of my bag.
After I got down, I saw that the phone was gone.
According to a passenger, Deepak Joshi had been standing close to me.
I had locked the phone with a password.
Deepak Joshi was later seen getting off at the next stop.
I request that my identity and address be kept safe.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the water tank, and its footage may help.
At that time, my cousin was with me.
I saw Deepak Joshi again near the water tank two days later.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

narrative: My name is Pramod Deshmukh. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a driver.
On 09.06.2026, at around 18:20, my family and I locked the house and left to visit relatives in a nearby village.
When we came back, I saw that the lock of the main door was broken.
Someone had taken gold ornaments and cash worth Rs. 600000 from the trunk in the store room.
We found that the side door of the house was open.
My neighbour told me that he had seen Arun Shah near my house that evening.
Arun Shah left on a blue motorcycle bearing number ZZ39EF9497.
The street lights in the area were working that night.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
At that time, my friend was with me.
I can identify the accused if I see him again.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the temple gate, and its footage may help.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

At around 1:05 PM on 14.12.2025, while I was walking near the temple gate, two men came up on a red motorcycle.
The pillion rider pulled the gold chain from my neck, and they sped away.
The chain is worth about Rs. 90,000.00 and weighed nearly twenty grams.
I noted the number of the motorcycle, which was ZZ-22-TU-9216.
People in the area later told me that the rider was Alok Khan.
When the chain was pulled, my neck was hurt.
A shop near the temple gate has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
A few days before the incident, on a Monday, I had seen the accused near my house.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs. 90,000.00.
I request that my identity and address be kept safe.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
My brother was with me at that time.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

Rohit Chauhan stopped me and started abusing me over an old dispute about a parking space.
He struck my left arm twice with a brick, and I fell to the ground.
He did say that he would kill me if I went to the police.
During the attack, my mobile phone worth Rs 43,222/- fell and was broken.
He escaped on a scooter with registration number ZZ-01-RS-9995.
A few days before the incident, on a Wednesday, I had seen the accused near my house.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the post office, and its footage may help.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
Please keep my identity and address safe.

I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs 43,222/-.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
I can identify the accused if I see him again.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

narrative: My name is Pooja Deshmukh. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a tailor.
At around 12:55 PM on 18-04-2025, a caller who claimed to be a bank officer phoned me.
The caller told me that my account would be blocked if I did not share a one-time password.
I did share the password with him.
Soon after, Rs. 1,64,959.00 was debited from my account in four transactions.
I later came to know that the money was sent to an account in the name of Mohan Kulkarni.
Mohan Kulkarni was seen visiting the bank branch on a motorcycle bearing number ZZ 36 GH 6717.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
I have never given money or property to the accused before.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
A shop near the vegetable market has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
At that time, my brother was with me.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

On 13 November 2024 at about 11:15 AM, I came to open my shop near the temple gate and found the shutter lock broken.
Someone had taken cash worth Rs 3,95,000/- from the locker.
In the shop, all the goods on the front shelf were lying on the floor.
The night watchman told me that he saw Shri Ashok Verma near the shop at midnight.
A red van bearing number ZZ10LM4271 was parked outside the shop that night.
The CCTV camera of the shop was working at that time.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
The incident took place near the temple gate, which is a busy area.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
A shop near the temple gate has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs 3,95,000/-.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Friday.
Two days later, I saw Shri Ashok Verma again near the temple gate.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

The night watchman told me that he saw Sanjay Bhatt near the shop at midnight.

I have not seen the accused after the incident.

I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
My brother was with me at that time.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.

fields.place_of_incident: Rose Garden Lane, near the government school
fields.complainant_address: House No. 155, Rose Garden Lane, Ambikanagar

narrative: My name is Rakesh Sinha. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a farmer.
At around 07.20 hrs on 5 January 2026, a message about a reward came on my mobile phone.
To receive the money, the message told me to scan a code.
Once I scanned the code, Rs 1,31,500/- was taken from my bank account.
As per the bank, the money went to an account of Lalit Mishra.
Before this, I had received such a message.
I informed the bank on its helpline number within an hour.
My brother was with me at that time.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
The place where it happened, near the government school, is usually busy.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs 1,31,500/-.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
Two days later, I saw Lalit Mishra again near the government school.
The street lights in the area were working that night.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

Anil Bisht stopped me there and abused me because of an old dispute about a water connection.
He struck my head twice with a wooden stick, and I fell to the ground.
He did threaten to kill me if I went to the police.
My mobile phone, worth Rs 9,662/-, fell and broke during the attack.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Nehru Park Extension, near the bus stand
fields.complainant_address: House No. 102, Bus Stand Road, Chandoli

narrative: I, Shri Satish Das, live at the above address with my family and work as a clerk.
On 14/06/2026, at around 7:40 AM, my family and I locked the house and left to visit relatives in a nearby village.
On our return, I found the lock of the main door broken.
Gold ornaments and cash worth Rs 6,00,000/- were missing from the wooden cupboard in the hall.
The kitchen door of the house was found open.
According to my neighbour, he had seen Mahesh Mishra near my house that evening.
Mahesh Mishra left on a red motorcycle bearing number ZZ 26 LM 2334.
Two days later, I saw Mahesh Mishra again near the bus stand.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
The place where it happened, near the bus stand, is usually busy.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

Please keep my identity and address safe.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.

I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

narrative: My name is Dinesh Khan. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a driver.
At around 3:20 PM on 20-01-2025, I was walking home from work near the bus stand.
Bharat Patel stopped me there and abused me because of an old dispute about a parking space.
He hit me twice on my head with a wooden stick, and I fell down.
He did threaten to kill me if I went to the police.
My mobile phone, worth Rs 22,000/-, fell and broke during the attack.
He ran away on a scooter bearing number ZZ 38 PQ 6868.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Friday.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
At that time, my brother was with me.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
I saw Bharat Patel again near the bus stand two days later.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the bus stand, and its footage may help.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
I have never given money or property to the accused before.
The place where it happened, near the bus stand, is usually busy.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

narrative: My name is Dinesh Khan. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a driver.

Bharat Patel stopped me there and abused me because of an old dispute about a parking space.
He hit me twice on my head with a wooden stick, and I fell down.
He did threaten to kill me if I went to the police.
My mobile phone, worth Rs 22,000/-, fell and broke during the attack.
He ran away on a scooter bearing number ZZ 38 PQ 6868.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Friday.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
At that time, my brother was with me.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
I saw Bharat Patel again near the bus stand two days later.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the bus stand, and its footage may help.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
I have never given money or property to the accused before.
The place where it happened, near the bus stand, is usually busy.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

narrative: My name is Geeta Nair. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a tailor.
On 22-08-2024 at about 10:50 AM, I was walking near the bus stand when two men came on a blue motorcycle.
The pillion rider pulled the gold chain from my neck, and they sped away.
The chain is worth about Rs. 1,31,000.00 and weighed nearly twenty grams.
Later, people in the area told me that the rider was Bharat Agarwal.
When the chain was pulled, my neck was hurt.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

Later, people in the area told me that the rider was Bharat Agarwal.
When the chain was pulled, my neck was hurt.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

Based on the evidence collected, this charge sheet is filed against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Patel Chowk, near the water tank
fields.court_name: Court of the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Bhavanpur

narrative: According to the complainant, Pankaj Deshmukh, an offence took place at Patel Chowk, near the water tank on 24-11-2024.
It was found that Rs 2,82,353/- had been taken from the complainant's account using a code sent by Naresh Pandey.
Witnesses at the spot identified the accused.
During questioning, the accused did admit his role.
The police seized a red motorcycle, number ZZ02RS5629, from the accused.
Statements of all witnesses were recorded, and the relevant documents were collected.
The accused has no earlier criminal record in Bhavanpur, as per available records.
Call records of the mobile numbers involved were collected.
The complainant's version is supported by all the witnesses.
The case property is kept safely in the police station store.
The accused was arrested and then produced before the court.
According to the witnesses, the incident took place at about 15:05.
A site plan of the place of occurrence was made.
During investigation, the seized property was identified by the complainant.
The complainant was examined, and the statement was recorded.
The CCTV footage from a shop near the water tank was checked.
On the basis of the evidence collected, this charge sheet is submitted against the accused.

narrative: According to the complainant, Smt Vandana Sandhu, an offence took place at Hospital Road, near the petrol pump on 19 February 2026.

During questioning, the accused did admit his role.
The police seized a grey motorcycle, number ZZ-05-PQ-8045, from the accused.
Statements of all witnesses were recorded, and the relevant documents were collected.
The concerned offices provided the relevant reports.
The accused was arrested and then produced before the court.
The accused Nitin Gill was found at his house.
The call records of the mobile numbers involved were obtained.
The accused has no earlier criminal record in Ambikanagar, as per available records.
The seized property was identified by the complainant.
The CCTV footage from a shop near the petrol pump was checked.
A site plan of the place of occurrence was made.
The complainant's version is supported by all the witnesses.
The complainant was examined, and the statement was recorded.
The investigation was completed within the time allowed.
On the basis of the evidence collected, this charge sheet is submitted against the accused.

The investigation was completed within the time allowed.

The accused did admit his role during questioning.
The police seized a grey motorcycle, number ZZ 35 XY 2669, from the accused.

Call records of the mobile numbers involved were collected.
The investigation was finished within the allowed time.
The seized property was identified by the complainant.
The version of the complainant is supported by all the witnesses.
The case property is safely kept in the store of the police station.
The accused has no earlier criminal record in Meghpura, as per available records.
On the basis of the evidence collected, this charge sheet is submitted against the accused.

narrative: According to the complainant, Pankaj Mehta, an offence took place at Patel Chowk, near the railway crossing on 29th Sep 2025.
It was found that Shri Gopal Joshi assaulted the complainant with a iron rod, causing injuries.
The accused was identified by witnesses at the spot.
The accused did admit his role during questioning.
A blue motorcycle bearing number ZZ08RS5794 was seized from the accused.
Statements of all witnesses were recorded, and the relevant documents were collected.
As per available records, the accused has no previous criminal record in Rajkhet.
The accused was arrested and then produced before the court.
The CCTV footage from a shop near the railway crossing was checked.
The investigation was completed within the time allowed.
During investigation, the seized property was identified by the complainant.
The accused Shri Gopal Joshi was found at his house.
The version of the complainant is supported by all the witnesses.
A site plan of the place of occurrence was made.
The relevant reports were obtained from the concerned offices.
The complainant was examined, and the statement was taken down.
According to the witnesses, the incident took place at about 2:05 PM.
Call records of the mobile numbers involved were collected.
The case property is safely kept in the store of the police station.
On the basis of the evidence collected, this charge sheet is submitted against the accused.

The accused has no earlier criminal record in Dhanauli, as per available records.
The investigation was completed within the time allowed.
Based on the evidence collected, this charge sheet is filed against the accused.

At around 9:05 PM on 20th Sep 2025, I was present near the vegetable market.
I saw Shri Tarun Menon pushing a motorcycle towards the main road.
Because the area was well lit, I could see his face clearly.
He left on a grey motorcycle bearing number ZZ05EF5609.
The complainant later told me that property worth Rs 1,20,000/- was involved.
As he lives in the same area, I know Shri Tarun Menon.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
A few days before the incident, on a Sunday, I had seen the accused near my house.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
I can identify the accused if I see him again.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
This statement is given by me of my own free will.

fields.place_of_incident: Hospital Road, near the railway crossing

narrative: I, Ravi Das, live in Rajkhet and work as a clerk.
On 10.09.2025 at about 16.45 hrs, I was near the railway crossing.
I watched Shri Kishan Yadav pull a chain off the complainant's neck.
I could see his face clearly because the area was well lit.
He went away on a blue motorcycle with registration number ZZ10RS4460.
Later, the complainant told me that property worth Rs. 61,000.00 was involved.
As he lives in the same area, I know Shri Kishan Yadav.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
A shop near the railway crossing has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
A few days before the incident, on a Sunday, I had seen the accused near my house.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
The street lights in the area were working that night.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
The incident took place near the railway crossing, which is a busy area.
I saw Shri Kishan Yadav again near the railway crossing two days later.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
This statement is given by me of my own free will.

fields.place_of_incident: Bus Stand Road, near the temple gate

narrative: I, Suman Sandhu, live in Meghpura and work as a farmer.
At around 10.00 hrs on 21st Jun 2025, I was present near the temple gate.
I saw Ravi Tiwari hitting the complainant with a iron rod.
Because the area was well lit, I could see his face clearly.
He went away on a grey motorcycle with registration number ZZ 07 JK 6509.
Later, the complainant told me that property worth Rs 13,000/- was involved.
As he lives in the same area, I know Ravi Tiwari.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
I saw Ravi Tiwari again near the temple gate two days later.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Wednesday.
I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
I have never given money or property to the accused before.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
The total loss in this matter is about Rs 13,000/-.
A shop near the temple gate has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
At that time, my cousin was with me.
I have given this statement of my own free will.

narrative: I, Smt Sunita Shukla, live in Meghpura and work as a farmer.
On 19th Mar 2025 at about 18:35, I was near the government school.
I watched Raghav Pillai strike the complainant with a brick.
I could see his face clearly because the area was well lit.
He left on a black motorcycle bearing number ZZ29PQ3987.
Later, the complainant told me that property worth Rs 21,000/- was involved.
I know Raghav Pillai because he lives in the same area.
My cousin was with me at that time.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
Two days later, I saw Raghav Pillai again near the government school.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the government school, and its footage may help.
The incident took place near the government school, which is a busy area.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Wednesday.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs 21,000/-.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I have given this statement of my own free will.

narrative: I, Smt Manju Pandey, live in Kesarpur and work as a farmer.

I watched Bharat Das strike the complainant with a wooden stick.
I could see his face clearly because the area was well lit.
He went away on a blue motorcycle with registration number ZZ-32-RS-1916.
The complainant later told me that property worth Rs 33,500/- was involved.
I know Bharat Das because he lives in the same area.
The place where it happened, near the public library, is usually busy.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
A shop near the public library has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
In this matter, the total loss is about Rs 33,500/-.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I saw Bharat Das again near the public library two days later.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
I have given this statement of my own free will.

narrative: I, Smt Savita Shukla, am a resident of the above address, and I am a farmer by profession.
On 16/03/2025 at about 17.50 hrs, I was crossing the road near the temple gate on foot.
A black car bearing number ZZ22RS6194 came at high speed and hit me.
The person driving the car was Dinesh Ghosh.
I was hurt on my right hand and had to be taken to the hospital.
The driver did stop to help me.
So far, I have spent about Rs. 1,70,759.00 on treatment.
The driver was talking on a mobile phone at that time.
The accused lives in the next lane.
Since that day, my children are scared to go out.
I came to report the matter without delay.
The incident may have been recorded by a camera outside a house near the temple gate.
I am ready to help the police in every way.
I had noticed the accused near the temple gate on a Saturday before the incident.
I am able to point out the accused if he is shown to me.
I suffered a total loss of about Rs. 1,70,759.00.
A few neighbours came out of their houses on hearing my shouts.
I request the police to register my complaint and take action as per law.

narrative: I, Smt Pushpa Agarwal, am a resident of the above address, and I am a clerk by profession.
At around 3:50 PM on 13 March 2025, I handed Rs. 499000 to Satish Thakur for buying goods for my shop.
He said that he would bring the goods within seven days.
He used the money for himself.
He told me that he would return the money next month.
He went away from the area on a motorcycle with registration number ZZ-11-PQ-4169.
On earlier occasions too, I had given him money.
Since that day, my children are scared to go out.
Three days later, I saw Satish Thakur once more near the petrol pump.
At the time, it was dark at that place.
I had earlier warned the accused to keep away from my house.
After the incident, the accused has avoided me.
The above was read out to me, and it is as I said.
I came to report the matter without delay.
The accused stays in the next lane.
I suffered a total loss of about Rs. 499000.
I will help the police in every way.
A camera outside a house near the petrol pump may have recorded the incident.
I am able to point out the accused if he is shown to me.
On a Thursday before the incident, I had noticed the accused near the petrol pump.
Please register my complaint and take action as per law.

fields.place_of_incident: Nehru Park Extension, near the government school
fields.court_name: Court of the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sitalpur

narrative: As per the complaint of Shri Naresh Saxena, an incident took place on 11/08/2025 at Nehru Park Extension, near the government school.
Investigation showed that Hemant Bose drove the car bearing number ZZ-19-PQ-9371 rashly and hit the complainant.
Eyewitnesses named the accused during the inquiry.
On being questioned, the accused did confess.
A red vehicle numbered ZZ-19-PQ-9371 was taken into police custody.
The police wrote down the accounts of all the witnesses and gathered papers.
The accused has no earlier case in Sitalpur, as per police records.
The accused was sent to the court after being taken into custody.
On seeing the recovered articles, the complainant did recognise them.
The spot was shown in a rough sketch.
Details of the phone numbers used were collected from the service provider.
The offices concerned sent the required papers.
The recovered articles are kept safely in the police station.
As per the witnesses, the incident happened at about 7:50 PM.
The complainant's statement was taken again.
Camera recordings from near the government school were collected and seen.
As the evidence gathered is enough, the accused is sent up for trial.

fields.place_of_incident: Hospital Road, near the bus stand
fields.court_name: Court of the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meghpura

narrative: As per the complaint of Jyoti Verma, an incident took place on 31/05/2026 at Hospital Road, near the bus stand.
Investigation showed that Dinesh Gupta kept Rs. 72000 that the complainant had given him for buying goods.
During the inquiry, eyewitnesses named the accused.
The accused did confess when he was questioned.
A black vehicle numbered ZZ 11 AB 1579 was taken into police custody.
The accounts of all the witnesses were written down, and papers were gathered.
The witnesses said the incident happened at about 11:45 AM.
Camera recordings from near the bus stand were collected and seen.
The complainant's account is backed by all the witnesses.
The police traced Dinesh Gupta to a relative's house.
Details of the phone numbers used were collected from the service provider.
Papers from the offices concerned were collected.
The accused was taken into custody and sent to the court.
The spot was shown in a rough sketch.
The inquiry was finished within the time fixed by law.
On seeing the recovered articles, the complainant did recognise them.
The evidence gathered is enough, and the accused is sent up for trial.

narrative: As per the complaint of Jyoti Verma, an incident took place on 31/05/2026 at Hospital Road, near the bus stand.
Investigation showed that Dinesh Gupta kept Rs. 72000 that the complainant had given him for buying goods.
During the inquiry, eyewitnesses named the accused.
The accused did confess when he was questioned.
A black vehicle numbered ZZ 11 AB 1579 was taken into police custody.
The accounts of all the witnesses were written down, and papers were gathered.
The witnesses said the incident happened at about 11:45 AM.
Camera recordings from near the bus stand were collected and seen.
The complainant's account is backed by all the witnesses.
The police traced Dinesh Gupta to a relative's house.
Details of the phone numbers used were collected from the service provider.
Papers from the offices concerned were collected.
The accused was taken into custody and sent to the court.
The spot was shown in a rough sketch.
The inquiry was finished within the time fixed by law.
On seeing the recovered articles, the complainant did recognise them.
The evidence gathered is enough, and the accused is sent up for trial.

The accused did confess when he was questioned.
A grey vehicle numbered ZZ-23-PQ-2227 was taken into police custody.

The witnesses said the incident happened at about 20:45.
The account of the complainant is backed by all the witnesses.
The spot was shown in a rough sketch.
Camera recordings from near the railway crossing were collected and seen.
Alok Joshi was traced to a relative's house.
The service provider gave details of the phone numbers used.
The evidence gathered is enough, and the accused is sent up for trial.

fields.place_of_incident: Gandhi Colony, near the post office

narrative: I, Gopal Gill, am a driver living in Navgarh.
At around 09:20 on 19th Apr 2026, I happened to be near the post office.
I was present when the complainant gave money to Manoj Bhatt.
The light was good, so I could make out his face.
He got away on a blue vehicle with the number ZZ-15-GH-9983.
The complainant later told me that the loss came to about Rs. 44,000.00.
I know Manoj Bhatt by face, as he stays nearby.
If the accused is shown to me, I am able to point him out.
On a Tuesday before the incident, I had noticed the accused near the post office.
Three days later, I saw Manoj Bhatt once more near the post office.
I reported the matter without any delay.
A camera outside a house near the post office may have recorded the incident.
The above was read out to me, and it is as I said.
I had earlier warned the accused to keep away from my house.
The total loss I suffered is about Rs. 44,000.00.
I have had no quarrel with the accused in the past.
I will help the police in every way.
The accused has avoided me after the incident.
What I have said above is true, and I have said it of my own accord.

Since that day, my children are scared to go out.

I suffered a total loss of about Rs 86,000/-.
What I have said above is true, and I have said it of my own accord.
